name: memvault
description: Local-first memory for AI agents: session-start recall, end-of-session extraction into a review inbox, and one MCP server shared by your agents.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first memory that follows you across agents.
interface.longDescription: One self-hosted memory for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Obsidian: automatic session-start recall, opt-in end-of-session extraction into a review inbox, semantic search, and a local MCP server. Data stays in ~/.memvault/data.db — no account, no cloud.
